request.query: integer multivariate polynomial coordinate degree bounds coefficients between zero and B

items.name: Polynomial.degree_le_iff_coeff_zero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (f : Polynomial R) (n : WithBot ℕ), f.degree ≤ n ↔ ∀ (m : ℕ), n < ↑m → f.coeff m = 0

items.name: Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_ne_zero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R}, p.coeff n ≠ 0 → n ≤ p.natDegree

items.name: Polynomial.card_mahlerMeasure_le_prod
items.type:
∀ (n : ℕ) (B : NNReal),
  {p | p.natDegree ≤ n ∧ (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℂ) p).mahlerMeasure ≤ ↑B}.ncard ≤
    ∏ i, (2 * ⌊↑(n.choose ↑i) * B⌋₊ + 1)

items.name: MvPolynomial.monomial_le_degreeOf
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (i : σ) {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {m : σ →₀ ℕ},
  m ∈ f.support → m i ≤ MvPolynomial.degreeOf i f

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_totalDegree
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (i : σ),
  MvPolynomial.degreeOf i f ≤ f.totalDegree
